instruction: Change the font size of all italicized instances of the word 'preorder' to 18 points while keeping italic formatting

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task targets specific italic word 'preorder' which appears 2 times in document (at paragraph indices 13 and 14). Evaluator checks those specific italic runs with text='preorder' have size 18pt.

llm_judge_reasons: Metric correctly iterates through all paragraphs and runs to find italic instances of target word
Correctly checks that run.italic is True AND run.text matches target_word (preorder)
Correctly verifies font size is 18pt using run.font.size.pt
Returns 0.0 if ANY italic instance fails check, 1.0 if all pass - correct all-or-nothing logic
Expected parameter correctly accessed as dictionary (not expected.get("rules")) - proper handling for type="rule"
Postconfig properly saves document with Ctrl+S before verification
Complete coverage: checks ALL italic instances of "preorder" as required by instruction
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The metric uses exact string match (run.text.strip() == target_word) which assumes "preorder" is in a single run. If the word is split across multiple runs with different formatting, it may not detect it. This is acceptable for typical documents but could be made more robust.
